description: CODE-4's composition-from-predication path (domains.code_write_growth.compose_write_shape_from_predication): a SMALL held vocabulary of morphological multiplier/offset words (Concept{name, multiplier_factor} / Concept{name, offset_delta}) a request's own content-word predicate can resolve against -- 'doubles' (mechanically stemmed to 'double' by stripping a trailing 's', the SAME status ast_to_term's fixed maps have: a fixed text-prep step, not a decision) resolves to Concept{name:'double', multiplier_factor:2}, which composes Times(Var(arg), Lit(2)) from the ALREADY-HELD DSL vocabulary CODE-1/2 read/evaluate -- never a fabricated Term shape. Teachable: a human can `teach(agent, 'Concept', {name:'quadruple', multiplier_factor:4})` to widen this vocabulary with zero code change; the composer only reads what's held. A predicate with no held Concept honestly exhausts (domains.code_write_growth.compose_write_shape_from_predication returns {ok: False, reason: 'composition exhausted: ...'}) -- the documented CODE-4 boundary: pure composition from predication covers this SMALL closed multiplier/offset family, not arbitrary English-to-Term synthesis (that remains the teach-by-example path's job).

microtheory.name: write_shape_predication
microtheory.description: morphological multiplier/offset words the write-composer can resolve to an arithmetic Term without an example
